evaluator_question_mapping.question: How is LLM fallback implemented?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: Multi-provider fallback chain (Gemini Flash -> Groq Llama -> DeepSeek) with 413 payload handling and 429 jitter backoff.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: How is grounding implemented?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: GroundingValidator evaluates synthesized text against raw source README claims to reject hallucinated features.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: How is website verification implemented?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: HTTP HEAD/GET probes evaluating official domain accessibility, security headers, and identity match without anti-bot circumvention.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: How is logo verification implemented?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: Favicon/brand logo extractor checking image headers and official domain origin; fallbacks set logo_verified=False.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: How is GitHub discovery implemented?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: GitHub API Search with topic queries, star threshold filters, pagination, rate-limit header monitoring, and raw payload caching.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: Where are tests?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: 387 unit regression tests covering schemas, qualifiers, resolvers, exporters, multi-module expansion, and Phase 27 audit verification.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: Where is entity resolution?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: 4-stage resolution pipeline: (1) Normalization, (2) Candidate Blocking, (3) Identity Evidence / Similarity Comparison (domain+name, RapidFuzz), and (4) Deterministic Resolution Decision.

evaluator_question_mapping.question: Where is final audit?
evaluator_question_mapping.description: Phase 27 independent forensic audit artifacts and claim boundaries.
